payload.name: ExtractExplicitProjectMentionsAsEvents
payload.description: Use during construction extraction when a message contains an explicit statement about finishing, working on, designing, or building a project, especially if the mention is brief or embedded in small talk.
content: During candidate extraction, whenever a speaker explicitly states they finished, are working on, designed, or built a project or accomplishment, create an `event` memory capturing the project domain/type and completion status, even if the mention is brief or part of small talk.
Include any explicit qualifiers stated in the same message (e.g., purpose, goal, or descriptive attributes) as part of the project description.
Do not skip memory generation solely because the surrounding conversation shifts to another topic or because the statement is short.

solves: When a user mentions a completed or ongoing project in passing during casual conversation, the construction agent sometimes fails to extract it because the surrounding dialogue is about other topics, leaving durable career/project facts missing from memory. This skill instructs extraction to treat explicit project/accomplishment statements as event candidates regardless of conversational context, so future questions about a person's projects/work history can be answered. Applies to any speaker statement explicitly describing finishing, working on, designing, or building a project.
